newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Reported bomb alert at Hebron negotiators' hotel.
newsitem.headline: Reported bomb alert at Hebron negotiators' hotel.

text.p: Palestinian and U.S. negotiators were suddenly evacuated from a Jerusalem hotel under heavy security on Monday in the midst of talks on a Hebron accord and a bomb squad and sniffer dogs was brought in, witnesses said.

Israeli television said information was received a bomb had been planted at the hotel. Witnesses said the Israeli team remained in the meeting room at Laromme Hotel's eighth floor while the other negotiators were whisked away.
